This skill facilitates using the x402 SDK to construct the Pharos x402 server and the corresponding test client. For Atlantic Testnet, configure chain ID 688689 and the test USDC token address (0xE0BE08c77f415F577A1B3A9aD7a1Df1479564ec8), which is not an official address. Ensure the generated server and client use these Atlantic Testnet settings.
